name: Paul Blatnak
career_history: Preconstruction Executive - Advanced Technology Group at Turner Construction, 5/2024 to present; Preconstruction Services at Turner Construction, 5/2020 to present; Preconstruction Services at PCL Construction, 7/2013 to 5/2020; Director of Preconstruction and Procurement at Kiewit, 12/2008 to 6/2013; Director at Icon Group, 1/2007 to 11/2008; Senior Estimator at GE Johnson Construction, 7/2005 to 1/2007; Estimator / Project Manager at JE Dunn Construction, 5/1999 to 6/2005
education: BS, Architectural Engineering, The University Of Kansas, 1995 to 2000
biography:
Focused experience in vertical construction markets including healthcare, mixed-use, residential, commercial, advanced technologies(battery, ev, bio-pharma, semi-conductor, data centers), industrial, manufacturing, hospitality, and government facilities. Additional experience in institutional, warehousing, cold storage facilities and infrastructure/civil.

For the last several years, I have been involved in infrastructure development optimization for clients to include planning for place-making opportunities, vertical construction and "smart city" approach. Understanding a clients "intent" for the property(s) is imperative to making the correct decision(s) early. This includes renewable energy projects such as utility scale solar installations and heat recovery systems.

I hope to improve the efficiencies and effectiveness of project teams (owner, designer, contractor, jurisdictional entities, etc.) to provide the highest quality project on time and on budget, while achieving project and stakeholder goals. This means listening to understand project success criteria, and managing scope and expectations. Always start with the end in mind.

Specialties: Design Management, Preconstruction, Estimating, and Project Management
